title: Fast fingering: Tio, Jimbo, Bigard and Nicholas
summary: Barnes says Tio and others were fast, Jimbo about the same, and that Bigard and Nicholas became fast only after going north.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
